div.div: عَيَّابٌ (S, A, O, Msb, K) and ↓ عَيَّابَةٌ (A, O, K [but this has a more intensive signification]) and ↓ عُيَبَةٌ (A, K) One [who finds fault with others, or] who attributes or imputes to others, or charges them with, or accuses them, of, vices, faults, &c., much, or often. (A and K in explanation of all, and O in explanation of the second.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
